translations.en: Anneberg
Do that, and I will at least spare your life.
Did that mean sparing you now, only to destroy you with the town later?
That would hardly save you in the end,
and there was no way you could hand over this book anyway.
You drew your sword and took a fighting stance.
So you choose to die here...
You really don't know when to give up.
So even demons such as @7rAnneberg@0r have appeared...
It seems time is running short.
@7rBeatrix@0r and her companions should be able to read that book.
Study it and learn to use the key.
This is as far as I shall guide you.
Farewell, child of humanity. Do not let the monsters have it.
With that, @7rLady Marbas@0r was enveloped in a glowing mist
and vanished along with it.
In any case, you had to return to the tavern with the @3rbook@0r.
You should head for town
before the monsters came to stop you taking it there.
An old painting hung on the wall.
It was an eerie painting of a burning hut.
This is it. This painting. The hut represents the town, the flames its destruction.
Exactly our current situation...
Then the town really will be destroyed?
Is that not what this one is running about trying to prevent?
If the hut represents the town and the flames its destruction,
then surely you must put out the flames.
But how could you extinguish them?
Do we throw @3rwater@0r on it?
Precisely. Find @3rwater@0r somewhere in this labyrinth
and bring it here.
Were you expected to find @3rwater@0r in the labyrinth? What an unreasonable task...
Had there been @3rwater@0r anywhere?
When you opened the box, you found it full of @3rwater@0r.
The @3rwater@0r was clear, but the thought of how long it might have sat there
made you reluctant to drink it.
Still, it would do perfectly well as @3rwater@0r to splash on a painting.
You filled a small box you found there with water
and decided to take it with you.
You obtained the "@3rBox of Water@0r."
You found what appeared to be the requested @3rjewelry box@0r.
It was unlocked and looked as though it would open.
Inside was a necklace
set with a large crystal pendant.
Within the crystal appeared the image of an intelligent-looking man
beside a smiling woman of such enchanting beauty
as you had never seen before.
That jewel holds an image of @7rChu Lu Gah@0r and me.
So this is where it was...
@7rChu Lu Gah@0r was a man who did not fall captive to my beauty.
That is why I helped him.
Though it was not my only reason.
The ancient seals seal a gate connecting another world to this one.
Should that world become connected to ours, its invaders
would destroy our beautiful scenery and everything else.
In the end, this very world would be swallowed by the other.
The humans here are utterly powerless against its inhabitants.
I loved the scenery of this world.
The landscapes, the air... I love it all.
That is why I helped protect the seals
and strengthen them further with magic circles.
I have no wish to see the world @7rChu Lu Gah@0r risked his life to protect
trampled underfoot by monsters.
That is also why I am helping you now.
I left your reward with that girl, @7rCarmine@0r.
Go back and collect it from her.
You handed the jewel to @7rLady Marbas@0r.
Thank you, child of humanity.
To cherish such an object as a keepsake... Perhaps I have grown old.
With that, @7rLady Marbas@0r vanished.
This was probably the main sanctuary of the temple.
It was crumbling, but resembled a small house.
A little house where an unknown god dwelled.
Yet the faint light seeping in from somewhere
bathed the temple in a soft, mysterious glow.
This must be the temple we're looking for...
The surroundings look ruined, but the sanctuary seems intact.
What could that clue mean?
Standing beside you, @7rBeatrix@0r tilted her head
and gazed at the temple before her.
